actionableComments.body: Please mention this in the changelog.

instructions: Read each body under `## Review summaries (first look)` and journal any warranted note before review mutations.
Commit and push any code changes.
Journal substantial decisions or rejections, citing item URLs or review IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to one sentence on what changed and run, even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest --reply-thread-ids rest-thread-990000 --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --adopt-existing-replies --require-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. Rerun the same command now.
